title: Personnel of King Oliver's band in 1933
summary: Phillips lists the band, including Les Holt on alto, Clifford MacTear on guitar, Francis Whitby, Arthur Williams, Pete Jones, Eddie Anderson, Debo Mills and Charlie Toran.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So he was playing long solos, too. We commented that he was the star of the band and he got a lot of solos and things -- he could take ten choruses on something.
Yeah! He got a lot of solos. Then we had an alto player there named... We called him Jack Holt; his name was Les Holt. He played a lot of solos. He was a good alto player. Very good.
Yeah. We named him Jack Holt.
Clifford MacTear. He was a good arranger.
So who else was in the King Oliver band besides MacTear?
I called them all. Jack Holt, Sam Adams, Francis Whitby, Arthur Williams, me, Pete Jones, Eddie Anderson who played bass, then Debo Mills who played the drums, and Charlie Toran on piano.
Dan Andrews on the string bass it says in here.
